product.title: Cortech Chuckwagon Jr. Tray Transport Cart - C1716
product.body_html:
The Cortech Chuckwagon Jr. food delivery cart is a one piece, insulated food tray delivery cart designed for continuous, intensive use in the toughest environments, making it the perfect fit for any Correctional Facility, Prison, or Jail's food delivery needs. The Chuckwagon Jr. insulated food tray delivery cart, has a true one piece molded cavity with no seams, no welded walls and no adhesives. The walls of the cart are filled with high grade insulation for maximum thermal retention. When used with either the Rock Food Trays or The X-Tray, the hot stays hot and the cold stays cold! The two insulated, hinge-less, sliding doors are easily removed for cleaning. The Chuckwagon Jr. is specially formulated with high impact polyethylene for maximum strength and impact resistance and is also chemically resistant to hazardous fluids and stains. The two insulated sliding doors, which are easily removed for cleaning, can be locked closed with the optional locking hasp.

  • Accommodates any tray up to 9 1/2 x 14 1/2
  • Raised top edge surface safely holds more trays, beverage servers and wash racks
  • Handle slots for easy navigation
  • Optional tamper-proof locking door latch system (order C1716LH)
  • Highest quality non-marring kingpin-less casters with quick change out design
  • Holds 60 X-Trays or 80 Rock trays (sold separately)
  • Built-in wall bumpers
  • Solid one-piece sliding doors. No dangerous hinges
  • Manufactured to ISO Quality Standards in the USA.
  • Dimensions: 30 W x 59 H x 42.75 L
  • Applications: Corrections, Behavioral Health, Mental Health, Law Enforcement, Schools and Universities, Military, Intensive-Use Environments, Recreational Facilities

About Cortech USA by Correctional Technologies:
Cortech USA (Correctional Technologies) manufactures products that are exceptionally durable, designed for use in compassionate and normative behavioral healthcare, corrections, law enforcement, heavy use commercial and industrial environments, parks and recreation, schools, universities, hospitals, emergency and homeless shelters, and other institutions and facilities where safety and durability matter. Cortech products are ideal for extreme use and intensive use environments.
